name: storyteller_short_style
purpose: Second target for Ren: the pace and wit for short episodes (under 90 s). Measurements only: no audio from the reference is stored or cloned.

reference.source: Instagram reel by clayrified_, 'A thief on his way to the gallows offered the king...', screen recording sent 3 Nov 2026
reference.note: A different person from both earlier references (voiceprint similarity 0.57 to the long-form storyteller, 0.41 to the viewer's voice). Same register as the long-form storyteller: about 1.4 semitones apart, too close to sit beside him in one cast.

voice.character: deep, warm, deadpan; the humour is in the understatement, never in the voice going up

pace.note: Fast but never rushed: many short breaths instead of a few long stops, and the one long pause (1.4 s) lands before the twist.

writing_habits: starts mid-action: 'Two guards drag a thief toward the gallows'
states the rule, then tests it on each character in turn, rising in rank
dry understatement for the laugh: 'He may have written down a wrong number here and there.'
turns the tale into an everyday lesson with three quick modern examples
ends on the call to follow, cut mid-word so the reel loops straight back to the start
video_habits: full 9:16 vertical, claymation characters with expressive faces
two or three words of caption at a time, bold yellow serif, centred low
a close-up on the key object (the seed, the necklace) at each turn of the story
cuts on every sentence; each shot shows the person the line is about
